text_block_list.text:
A magazine interview request came in for 
Silence Suzuka. Its contents were—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"‘Exclusive Interview! A deep dive into 
popular Umamusume's private lives’—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Is there really anything about my 
private life worth doing a whole feature 
on?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Umm... a little.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, I was chosen because of 
requests from the fans. But...
choice_data_list: Let me help you, if you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Please do. I'm not very confident in my 
ability to answer well, though...

And so, as practice for Silence Suzuka, I 
decided to ask her questions similar to 
those in past interviews, but—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer. I'll leave it to you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: My hobbies? Um, let's see—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Running... I suppose?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: My special skill is... running, too.
choice_data_list: ...How do you spend your days off?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, on my days off I always go running—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "...W-What should we do, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
What is it about me that the fans would 
like to know...?
choice_data_list: I want to know the real Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Just as it is—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you saying that my answer just now 
is acceptable?"

The fans cheering for Silence Suzuka are 
surely captivated by the way she runs.

I explained that answering honestly would 
probably make them happiest of all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Understood.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If you say so, Trainer... then I'm sure it 
will be all right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I'll answer with confidence—just being 
true to myself."

From that point on, Silence Suzuka would 
confidently answer "Running" whenever she 
was asked that question.

A few days later, Silence Suzuka's 
interview was reportedly well-received by 
fans, who said it showed just how much she 
truly loves to run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The way to answer... is it?

I told Silence Suzuka that even with the 
same answer, changing how she phrases it 
will completely alter the impression it 
gives.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, in other words—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
My hobby is running... and not just 
running, but searching for beautiful 
scenery while I run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"My special skill is... being able to keep 
running forever."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"And on my days off, I go looking for new 
running spots and such..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —I-Is it something like this?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Really? Thank goodness... Interviews are 
tough work, aren't they?

Later on, Silence Suzuka's interview was 
well-received by fans, highlighting how 
she's constantly thinking about running 
even in her private life.
